tool.name: 3Dtrees: Raster
tool.description: forest-structure metrics, DTM, CHM and voxel counts
tool.command: cp '$point_cloud' 'input.$point_cloud.ext' && #if $area.restrict == 'yes': cp '$area.aoi' aoi.geojson && #end if mkdir -p output && Rscript /opt/foreststructure/run_julia_memory_safe.R --point-cloud 'input.$point_cloud.ext' #if $area.restrict == 'yes': --aoi-geojson aoi.geojson #end if --instance-dimension '$instance_dimension' --denoise '$denoising.denoise' #if $denoising.denoise == 'sor': --denoise-neighbors '$denoising.denoise_neighbors' --denoise-sigma '$denoising.denoise_sigma' --denoise-window-size '$denoising.denoise_window_size' --denoise-buffer '$denoising.denoise_buffer' #end if --tile-size '$advanced.tile_size' --grid-search-step '$advanced.grid_search_step' --voxel-resolution '$advanced.voxel_resolution' --voxel-count-resolution '$advanced.voxel_count_resolution' --dtm-resolution '$advanced.dtm_resolution' --chm-resolution '$advanced.chm_resolution' --ptd-resolution '$advanced.ptd_resolution' --vegetation-minimum-height '$advanced.vegetation_minimum_height' --gap-height-threshold '$advanced.gap_height_threshold' --minimum-tree-voxels '$advanced.minimum_tree_voxels' --apex-minimum-height '$advanced.apex_minimum_height' --minimum-tree-thickness '$advanced.minimum_tree_thickness' --minimum-occupied-layers '$advanced.minimum_occupied_layers' --output-dir output --temp-dir "\${TMPDIR:-\$_GALAXY_JOB_TMP_DIR}"

param.name: point_cloud
param.label: Segmented point cloud
param.help: One full-resolution point cloud with at least one tree instance dimension (PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM) and a projected metric CRS.

param.name: restrict
param.label: Restrict to an area of interest
param.help: Without an area of interest the full point-cloud extent is analysed.

param.name: aoi
param.label: Area of interest
param.help: Polygon or MultiPolygon (GeoJSON) in the point cloud's coordinate system; it is not reprojected. Only whole tiles and voxel cells inside it are reported.

param.label: Instance dimensions
param.help: Type one or more of PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT and PredInstance_FM, separated by commas without spaces. Each must exist in the point cloud, otherwise the job fails.

validator.message: Enter PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT or PredInstance_FM, separated by commas without spaces

param.label: Point-noise filtering
param.help: Statistical outlier removal flags isolated points before the terrain model and metrics. Raw voxel counts always include every recorded point.

param.label: Neighbours
param.help: Nearest neighbours used for each point's mean distance.

param.label: Standard deviations
param.help: Points farther than the window mean plus this many standard deviations are flagged. The conservative default targets extreme outliers only.

param.label: Window size (m)
param.help: Width of the fixed windows that define the outlier statistics.

param.label: Window context (m)
param.help: Context around each window included in its statistics.

section.name: advanced
section.title: Advanced parameters
section.help: Defaults are the published 3Dtrees settings. Every run records the values it used in its run provenance.

param.label: Tile size (m)
param.help: Width of the square analysis tiles.

param.label: Tile-grid search step (m)
param.help: Step of the offset search that places the tile grid. Must not exceed the tile size.

param.label: Metric voxel size (m)
param.help: Voxel edge length for the tile and tree metrics.

param.label: Voxel count size (m)
param.help: Voxel edge length, horizontal and vertical, of the voxel point counts.

param.label: Ground-seed resolution (m)
param.help: Seed resolution of the progressive TIN densification (PTD) ground classification.

param.label: Gap height threshold (m)
param.help: CHM height below which a cell counts as a canopy gap.

param.label: Minimum tree voxels
param.help: Occupied metric voxels a segment needs to be accepted as a tree.

param.label: Minimum apex height (m)
param.help: A tree's highest point must be strictly above this height.

param.label: Minimum tree thickness (m)
param.help: Smallest PCA extent a tree must reach.

param.label: Minimum occupied layers
param.help: One-metre height layers a tree must occupy.

tool.help:
# What it does
3Dtrees: Raster computes fixed-size tile metrics of forest structure (20 m tiles by default) from one segmented point cloud. It also writes a digital terrain model (DTM), a canopy height model (CHM), full-resolution voxel point counts (0.5 m voxels by default) and provenance records. No points are subsampled, and the input file is never modified.
# Input
- **Segmented point cloud**: one full-resolution LAS/LAZ or COPC file with a projected metric CRS and at least one supported tree instance dimension: `PredInstance`, `PredInstance_SAT` (SegmentAnyTree) or `PredInstance_FM` (ForestMamba). The tool recognizes a COPC from its file content. - **Restrict to an area of interest** (default No): select Yes to supply a GeoJSON polygon in the point cloud's XY coordinates. Only whole tiles and voxel columns inside it are reported. - **Instance dimensions**: the dimensions to process. Type at least one of PredInstance, PredInstance_SAT and PredInstance_FM, separated by commas without spaces; the job fails if a named dimension is missing from the point cloud. - **Point-noise filtering**: statistical outlier removal (SOR) runs by default. It flags points whose mean distance to their nearest neighbours is extreme within 60 m windows by default. The terrain model, canopy model and tile metrics use the accepted points. It works on canonical COPC and plain LAS/LAZ; a plain file is numbered in its own record order. Select **None** to skip it. - **Advanced parameters**: tile size, voxel sizes, raster resolutions and the tree-acceptance thresholds. Leave the defaults to stay comparable with other 3Dtrees products.
CPU, memory and scratch space come from the Galaxy job allocation. The tool reduces its parallelism to fit the memory it is given and fails explicitly when a single spatial window cannot fit.
# Outputs
Per instance dimension (collections named by dimension):
- **Tile metrics**: one row per tile with vegetation density, height statistics, vertical complexity, canopy roughness and tree statistics. - **Segment diagnostics**: the tree-acceptance checks for each segment. - **Tiles**: the tile metrics as GeoJSON polygons.
Shared:
- **DTM** and **CHM** GeoTIFFs and a PNG tile overview. - **Voxel point counts**: occupied voxels as CSV, a multiband UInt32 GeoTIFF (with voxel size s, band b holds heights from (b-1)×s to b×s above the DTM), a validity raster (0 excluded, 1 valid, 2 invalid DTM) and grid metadata. Counts include every recorded point, also those flagged by SOR. Zero means no recorded points; read the validity raster before interpreting missing CSV rows. - **Rejected noise points** (with SOR): one `OriginalPointIndex` per row, and a **Denoising report** with parameters and per-window accounting. - **Run provenance** and **Analysis footprint** records.
Heights have no upper cutoff. Density and vertical complexity use a height domain derived from the tallest accepted point, recorded as `metric_height_upper_m` in every tile row; compare surveys with that in mind.
